title: OpenAEV scenario metadata
description: Metadata of one scenario entry (scenario.yaml). Draft until the format is confirmed on the starter-pack scenarios.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema the file follows.

external_id.description: The scenario's identifier: a UUID in lower case, chosen once, that never changes from one version to the next.

version.description: The scenario's version, in semantic versioning: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

status.description: VERIFIED for a scenario in use; DEPRECATED for one replaced or no longer maintained; REVOKED for one that must no longer run.

name.description: The scenario's name, as the platform shows it.

description.description: What the scenario does and why, for a reader who decides whether to run it.

severity.description: How severe the threat the scenario reproduces is.

category.description: The scenario's category, as the platform classifies it.

main_focus.description: What the scenario mainly tests, as the platform classifies it.

type.description: time-based: injects run at set times; chained: each inject runs when the previous one succeeds or fails.

platforms.description: A catalogue facet chosen by the contributor; it must include every platform targeted by an inject that needs an executor, which is checked against the export. At least one value, so that the scenario appears under some platform filter; for instance Generic for a scenario that runs on no endpoint.

threat.description: The threat the scenario reproduces: at least one of its CVEs, intrusion sets or techniques.

cves.description: CVE identifiers the scenario checks, such as CVE-2024-3400.

intrusion_sets.description: Names of the intrusion sets (threat actors) whose behaviour the scenario reproduces.

ttps.description: MITRE ATT&CK techniques the injects play, such as T1595 or T1595.002.

sources.description: Public sources about the threat, so that a reader can check what the scenario plays.

url.description: The address of the source, over HTTPS.

tlp.description: The Traffic Light Protocol level of the source: only TLP:CLEAR, since the repository is public.

title.description: A short title of the source.

requires.description: What a platform needs to run the scenario.

openaev.description: The platform versions the scenario runs on, as a constraint such as >=3.261005.0.

edition.description: The OpenAEV edition the scenario needs: CE (Community) or EE (Enterprise).

injectors.description: Types of the injectors the injects use, which the platform must have.

executors.description: Types of the executors the injects need on the targeted endpoints, if any.

payloads.description: References to the payloads the scenario uses, each by its identifier, version and hash.

targets.description: The targets a user must provide on their own platform; the scenario ships with none.

placeholder.description: A short name for the target, in kebab-case.

description.description: What the user must provide as this target.

generated_by.description: A short label of the tool or pipeline that generated the scenario, when one did.

relevance.description: Optional scores between 0 and 1: how urgent the scenario is (priority) and how closely it reproduces the threat (threat_fidelity).

priority.description: How urgent running the scenario is, from 0 to 1.

threat_fidelity.description: How closely the scenario reproduces the threat, from 0 to 1.

version.description: The payload version the scenario uses.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the payload's content, so that a platform can check it.
